element/fire/aoe/eruption.name: Lửa phun
element/fire/aoe/eruption.desc: flame tongues erupt from the ground over a dark smoke mass, flicker for a moment, then are eaten in place into rising pieces; the hot pool at the foot goes last and embers rise after it

element/fire/aoe/pillar.name: Cột lửa
element/fire/aoe/pillar.desc: a tall narrow column of fire: fewer, longer tongues close together, burning longer

element/fire/aoe/wildfire.name: Lửa lan
element/fire/aoe/wildfire.desc: a low wide blaze spreading over the ground: many tongues fanned wide

explosion/blast/blast.name: Nổ
explosion/blast/blast.desc: a pointed flash, flames thrown up and out over a dark smoke mass, a ring racing out, scraps in every direction, embers after

explosion/blast/small.name: Nổ nhỏ
explosion/blast/small.desc: a small burst: a bomb, a barrel

force/shock/bloom.name: Hoa nổ
force/shock/bloom.desc: an explosion shaped like a flower: rays rush in, a white flash, then three tiers of petals blast open with a shock ring, embers fly from the petal tips and the petals tear away from the empty centre

force/shock/drill.name: Khoan xoắn
force/shock/drill.desc: a spear of light inside a double helix that screws forward fast; the tip bites off small rings, sparks spiral off, then the coils unwind outward and the tip flies on alone

force/shock/inferno.name: Hỏa xung tầng
force/shock/inferno.desc: a burning punch: rays rush into an orb at the fist, a spiky white flash fuses with a white-hot beam, a dark-red ring stands around the fist, and four tiers of broken calligraphic fire rings fly out with a faint pressure front ahead; the first ring travels farthest and grows widest, every ring cools, fades and breaks into hooks and chips, while bright tracers with arrow heads, sparks and rising embers scatter forward

force/shock/shatter.name: Vòng vỡ
force/shock/shatter.desc: a thick ring slams in, overheats and cracks at eight points (two frames of glowing cracks), then bursts: the arcs tumble outward with hot fracture faces, chips fly from every crack and an energy ring escapes from the middle

force/shock/tiers.name: Tầng vòng
force/shock/tiers.desc: a hot flash at the contact, then three 3D rings born a frame apart along a bright axis streak; they shoot forward accelerating, overshoot, leave motion echoes and shed sparks from their tips

force/shock/vapor.name: Nón hơi
force/shock/vapor.desc: a sonic-boom pressure cone: a hot spearpoint pierces forward while three shells of compressed air peel back from it along flow lines; their mouths curl off into eddies and motes stream back

impact/burst/probe.name: Probe (tạm)
impact/burst/probe.desc: temporary effect used to test the build

impact/dash/comet.name: Sao chổi
impact/dash/comet.desc: speed thorns converge from behind into a forward-pointing burst at the contact; slivers keep flying ahead

impact/dash/pierce.name: Xuyên vòng
impact/dash/pierce.desc: a white bulge punches through a standing ring of air while long thorns stream back along the dash like a comet

impact/dash/wall.name: Vách lưỡi liềm
impact/dash/wall.desc: a tall white crescent slams up at the contact, its back edge torn into short curled thorns that trail along the dash; droplets peel off both tips

impact/ground/crater.name: Vòng chấn đất
impact/ground/crater.desc: a spiky ring flat on the ground races out from the impact while a short burst of light stands up in the middle; rocks are thrown to both sides and small dust puffs rise where the ring dies

impact/ground/geyser.name: Phun đất
impact/ground/geyser.desc: a fountain of light thorns shoots straight up from the impact over a low dust skirt, then droplets rain back down while the skirt rolls outward

impact/ground/slam.name: Nện bụi
impact/ground/slam.desc: a fist or weapon slams the floor: light thorns erupt out of a rolling dust bank (a dark back bank and a light front bank, both rolling outward), pebbles arc to both sides, the middle clears first

impact/hit/chevron.name: Mũi chéo
impact/hit/chevron.desc: a directional spray: two wide wings open into a chevron from the contact, thorns and slivers stream away along the hit

impact/hit/cross.name: Chữ thập chí mạng
impact/hit/cross.desc: the critical hit: four long straight pillars in an X, four short curled thorns between them, a thin ring racing out and droplets off the pillar tips

impact/hit/ring.name: Vòng gai
impact/hit/ring.desc: a spiky ring: the core is punched out from the start and keeps widening, its rim stays white-hot while thorns of three sizes spray off the outside

impact/hit/star.name: Nổ sao
impact/hit/star.desc: the classic hit spark: a white-hot core with two long hero thorns, four medium and three nubs curling one way, two straight rays across it, droplets flung from the hero tips

impact/quake/shockwave.name: Sóng chấn động
impact/quake/shockwave.desc: a magic ground wave: two flat rings one after the other, a tall flash, no dust

impact/quake/slam.name: Nện đất
impact/quake/slam.desc: a weapon or a fist slams the floor: a pointed flash stands up from the impact, a flat shock ring races out on the ground, a dark dust bank behind and a light one in front roll out to both sides with unequal lobes and pointed tails, scraps are thrown up and fall back; the dust opens from the middle and is eaten in place last

impact/quake/stomp.name: Dậm chân
impact/quake/stomp.desc: a landing or a stomp: a small flash, low dust rolling out, no ring

impact/spark/crit.name: Chí mạng
impact/spark/crit.desc: a different drawing from the heavy hit, not a bigger one: a long slim cross (four near-square points) over a short five-point burst with a big white core held for two frames, two shock rings a beat apart, long speed lines and big scraps in every direction

impact/spark/heavy.name: Trúng đòn nặng
impact/spark/heavy.desc: a bold pointed flash in three stacked tones bursts at the contact point and breaks into needles; a shock ring behind it, speed lines along the blow, curved scraps thrown forward that outlive everything

impact/spark/light.name: Trúng đòn nhẹ
impact/spark/light.desc: a quick small pointed flash and a few scraps: for fast, weak hits

magic/arcane/aoe/crystals.name: Pha lê bùng
magic/arcane/aoe/crystals.desc: hard-edged crystal spikes with lit facets snap out of the ground in front of a see-through veil of wings, a flat ring on the floor; the veil is eaten into an outline of curved slivers, the spikes thin away

magic/arcane/aoe/frost.name: Gai băng
magic/arcane/aoe/frost.desc: the same eruption as ice: more, lower spikes fanned wide, no veil

magic/spirit/soulstrike.name: Xuất hồn kích
magic/spirit/soulstrike.desc: spirit flames are born at the caster's chest, swell and fan out; six spirits of three sizes (the big one a layered blue flame, the small ones flat-shaded teardrops) each take their own path and strike one after another, every hit a bright organic splash of its own shape (a chevron on the torso, a hollow ring at the back of the head, a star flat on the floor, the climax on the head, a fountain at the chest); a spiky crater ring races out on the floor and independent soul flames stand in three rows (dark violet behind, blue, bright cyan in front), each with its own sway, flicker, life and fate (sink, split, tip floats off). The target point is 340 px ahead of the anchor; no target body is drawn

melee/blade/swirl_fire.name: Xoáy chém lửa
melee/blade/swirl_fire.desc: a pink-fire swirl slash: a thick yellow band outside, pink then crimson inside, an amber rim, each boundary smooth with a few hand-placed flame licks pointing back along the sweep; a straight needle tail; it sweeps 330 degrees in four drawings, curls into the centre, cools (yellow first) and breaks into four claw pieces of different sizes; stepped flat glow

melee/blade/swirl_frost.name: Xoáy chém băng
melee/blade/swirl_frost.desc: a frost swirl slash made of two shapes side by side: a white blade on the outside and a blue flame on the inside with a few large cyan feathers and deep streaks, split by a thin dark seam; it sweeps over a flat see-through after-image, the white shrinks, holes open, it breaks into pieces and thin cracks fade in steps; stepped flat glow

melee/blade_aura/charge_blue.name: Tụ lực lưỡi đao (xanh)
melee/blade_aura/charge_blue.desc: blue energy that gathers in a weapon: a source ignites at the hilt, a front rises along the blade to the tip, then bright pulses keep running hilt to tip; discreet (it is a status); flat tiers (deep, blue, ice, white), two see-through bands and a two-scale glow around the blade, a few rising specks drawn on twos; it does not fade out, so it can run through a skill

melee/blade_aura/charge_fire.name: Tụ lực lưỡi đao (lửa)
melee/blade_aura/charge_fire.desc: fire that catches along a weapon: a source ignites at the hilt, the fire spreads along the blade to the tip with a bright head, flat flame tongues (orange, amber, pale core) of different sizes lick up from the lit blade and flicker on twos, embers rise and shrink; discreet (it is a status) and it does not fade out; same timeline and drawing core as charge_blue

melee/slash/axe.name: Chém rìu
melee/slash/axe.desc: an AXE swing: a short, thick smear of 4-6 parallel bands apart by narrow gaps, a blunt head; it fades band by band from the tail, the thin ones first, into parallel strokes

melee/slash/axe_heavy.name: Chém rìu lớn
melee/slash/axe_heavy.desc: a great AXE: a wider, longer-lived smear of six bands, more scraps

melee/slash/crescent.name: Chém lưỡi liềm
melee/slash/crescent.desc: a SWORD smear swept from a to b: a smooth crescent of three touching strands, a needle tail, a fat belly on the inside of the bow, a darker inner tone, a hot clean outer edge, two hair streaks beside it; it fades into two or three long thin strokes that run the way of the swing; scraps fly off the end

melee/slash/heavy.name: Chém nặng
melee/slash/heavy.desc: a great SWORD (a big blade): a wider, deeper bow, a second fainter smear behind it, more scraps

melee/slash/thrust.name: Đâm thẳng
melee/slash/thrust.desc: a straight SWORD thrust or dash: the same smear with no bow, thin and fast, a small flash where it ends

ranged/bolt/bolt.name: Đạn năng lượng
ranged/bolt/bolt.desc: a small flash where it is fired, a teardrop head with a living trail flies to the target, then a pointed impact with a ring and scraps thrown on along the flight

ranged/bolt/fireball.name: Cầu lửa
ranged/bolt/fireball.desc: a thrown fireball on a bowed path: a bigger head, then flames erupt at the target over dark smoke and embers rise

ranged/bolt/frost.name: Mũi băng
ranged/bolt/frost.desc: an ice shard: a slim fast head, crystals snap out of the target
